objective.statement: Make automatic Codex coordination use its proven owned session and retain secure capability replay.
objective.measure: The hook sends its Codex root session rather than the foreign bare principal.

need.statement: The automatic hook reuses a foreign-owned bare session.
need.baseline: Live trace rejected bare session; direct root session succeeded.
assumptions: The observed root suffix is the intended Codex hook session.
alternatives_considered: Use the observed owned root session

admission.reason: Operator-directed source repair; trusted purpose admission receipt unavailable in this client.

purpose: Restore automatic Codex coordination without taking over a foreign inbox.
contract: When clientLabel is codex, CoordinationBus shall use `${principal}-root` as session and persist/replay capability only for that session.
failure_boundary: Hook remains fail-open; it must not log the signed capability or alter foreign bare-session state.

evidence.description: Codex hook contract test fails on a bare session and passes when subscribe carries the root session.
Activated hook receives a successful root-session sweep without exposing capability text.

falsifier.claim: Codex automatic hook uses the owned root session.

executable_check.description: A bare session assertion or failed root-session test falsifies the contract.

non_goals: Claiming, deleting, or migrating foreign bare inboxes
invariants: principal remains derived from the Codex identity
inbox_uri remains secret and is stored in its separate mode-0600 file

assumptions.statement: The live successful root session is the intended stable Codex session namespace.
assumptions.falsifier: A focused hook test or live sweep shows root collides or is rejected.

plane_constraints: Home Manager owns deployment; repo-memory owns session authorization.
